paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 μeV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (KSVZ model, dimensionless ratio × g_KSVZ_agamma)
notes: Paper reports exclusion of dark matter axions with coupling g_agamma ≳ 0.93 × g_KSVZ_agamma at 90% CL in the mass range 21.86–22.00 μeV. The KSVZ coupling constant g_KSVZ_agamma ≈ 1.0 × 10^-16 GeV^-1 (standard value for KSVZ model). The experiment is a cavity haloscope (CAPP-12T) with a 12 T magnetic field, multi-cell cavity design, and Josephson Parametric Amplifier readout. Local DM density assumed is ρ_a = 0.45 GeV/cm³ (standard galactic halo value for KSVZ axions). The exclusion limit is encoded as a horizontal line spanning the stated mass range.
